snippet.title: Cardstronaut Gameplay Trailer 2
snippet.description:
The Gameplay trailer of Cardstronaut which is a roguelike deckbuilding 1D tactics game where the enemies move left/right and you must balance fuel and keep it in the exact range before you end your turn to activate the flame throwers.

Play the alpha build: https://cyclone2048.itch.io/cardstronaut

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177510/Cardstronaut/

Discord: https://discord.gg/EbcPjYSRsk
